capabilities: : Synchronize Markdown, Canvas, Bases, documents, and attachments.
: Manage multiple Streamient projects and OAuth accounts.
: Handle two-way synchronization on desktop and mobile.
: Manage offline queue and revision cursors.
: Support saved URLs with metadata round-tripping.
extras: Requires a Streamient account and connects only to the configured server; vault content is sent over TLS and encrypted at rest by Streamient.
intentEvidence: Synchronize Markdown, Canvas, Bases, documents, and attachments between one Obsidian vault and multiple hosted or self-hosted Streamient projects.
problem: Users need a way to synchronize their local Obsidian vault content with external Streamient knowledge projects.
summary: Synchronizes Obsidian vault content, including Markdown, Canvas, and attachments, with multiple hosted or self-hosted Streamient projects.
